instruction:
Reconcile this Cascade Timber litigation email collection. Use only the supplied packet. Each document is one original message; count it once. Quoted/forwarded headers and body statements are NOT additional original messages or recipients. Use only the top-level Date, From, To and Cc headers. Ignore Bcc and attachments. Normalize email addresses and domains to lowercase. Cascade = cascadetimber.com; L&L Associates = llassociates.com; Bellhaven Advisory = bellhavenadvisory.com; Alder Point Partners = alderpointpartners.com. Distinct domains are distinct organizations for this inventory, without making privilege or liability judgments.
Return JSON only: {"answers":{"Q01":<answer>,...,"Q12":<answer>}}. Counts must be positive integers. For ID sets use arrays with no duplicates (any order); empty sets are []. For ranked answers array order matters. Mapping keys must use the exact formats requested. Answer every question.
The reward is the mean of 12 question scores. For count mappings, score = correctly counted keys / union of submitted and expected keys. For ID sets, score = set F1 (both empty earns 1). For ordered arrays, score = correctly positioned entries / longer array length. Missing or malformed answers score 0. Extra top-level fields, unknown question IDs and duplicate JSON keys invalidate the whole submission. No tools are provided in this single-turn evaluation.
packet_selection: Original 75-document packet plus 225 sampled without replacement from lexicographically sorted remaining source paths using Python random.Random(20261008); then shuffled with the same generator. Development calibration, not held-out.
